source_findings.deselect: Native Alert.alert Cancel/Confirm; Confirm→setActiveCall(null)→remove persisted activeCallId,clear local call/priority/id. No server call/status write. Web uses window.confirm, hence native footage is genuinely a different platform branch.
source_findings.set_active: Detail Set Active selects the call and opens the status wizard; sidebar call selection only selects context. Neither is equivalent to a submitted unit response.
source_findings.close: CloseCallBottomSheet resets Notify=true, submits selectedClosedType1 plus Note/SendNotification, navigates/reloads Calls. Detail-store closure does not clear core activeCall or refresh unit status.
source_findings.release: Only live active/dispatched call with explicit group/unit dispatch recipients invokes release. Guard keeps units alreadyAvailable/Unavailable/Delayed or latest-pointing to a different open call. Otherwise per-unit-type custom override or department target resolution applies; built-in fallbackReleased10. Original older dispatch alone does not override latest ownership of the new call.
source_findings.source_seed_vs_current_config: Seed creates Ambulance unit type without CustomStatesId/overrides. It is not proof no later current configuration exists; read current normal controls before claiming a particular auto-release outcome.
source_findings.gps: Built-in source statuses have optional note and no GpsRequired initializer. Required GPS branch explicitly requests a live fix; denied permission stops it. Nonrequired branch reads recent only when permission granted,otherwise null; location store is not persisted. Never claim zero/seeded/map coordinates as a physical fix.
source_findings.notes: Plain Call Notes passes null coordinates and has Add Note; protected/redacted notes remain protected.
source_findings.ipad_menu: Unit calls ActionSheetIOS on iOS. Installed ReactNative RCTActionSheetManager supplies parent-view popover fallback when no anchor; do not patch/fake an iPad menu before actually observing it.
source_findings.harness: Existing held recorder was scoped to inventory. A new separately reviewed owned-call handler must bind actual new ID/title,normal native Deselect Cancel/Confirm,CloseType/NotifyOFF and permitted note/status inputs. Do not bypass generic alert/Submit guards by identifiers.
